description:
Watch as the team hunts rare vintage parts and classic vehicles, bringing forgotten machines back to life. From sourcing hard-to-find components for a wartime Willys Jeep to uncovering 1950s and 1960s trucks, iconic Shovelhead motorcycles, 1970s bikes, and Mach 1 Mustangs, the hunt is full of timeless iron and unforgettable restorations.
#Discovery #FilthyFortunes

About Filthy Fortunes:
In a modern-day treasure hunt, Matt "King of Hoards" Paxton gambles that he can find big-ticket items buried inside dangerous, out-of-control clutter.
